methodology_note: Numerator: AISHE 2021-22 enrolment. Denominator: Census 2011 C-15 population (15-19 + 20-24) × 0.6 as an 18-23 proxy (single-year-age table not pulled). Published national GER 2021-22 = 28.4% (MoSPI projected denominator); our 2011-denominator computation sits ~2-3pp above due to projection vs Census gap. The Muslim-vs-national gap is the story and is robust to the choice of denominator. Total enrolment 4,32,68,181 from AISHE 2021-22 Report p29 prose. Muslim enrolment is the published All-India 'Muslim Minority' total from AISHE Table 15 (the official aggregate, not a sum of state rows). Muslim numerator: 2,108,033; Muslim 18-23 proxy: 21,445,159.

Numerator: AISHE 2021-22 enrolment. Denominator: Census 2011 C-15 population (15-19 + 20-24) × 0.6 as an 18-23 proxy (single-year-age table not pulled). Published national GER 2021-22 = 28.4% (MoSPI projected denominator); our 2011-denominator computation sits ~2-3pp above due to projection vs Census gap. The Muslim-vs-national gap is the story and is robust to the choice of denominator. Total enrolment 4,32,68,181 from AISHE 2021-22 Report p29 prose. Muslim enrolment is the published All-India 'Muslim Minority' total from AISHE Table 15 (the official aggregate, not a sum of state rows). National numerator: 43,268,181; national 18-23 proxy: 139,170,403.

AISHE groups every non-Muslim minority into one 'Other Minority Community' (Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) and never splits them, so this is the finest community comparison the source allows. Numerator: published All-India Other Minority enrolment (9,05,159) from AISHE 2021-22 Report prose alongside the Muslim Minority figure. Denominator: Census 2011 C-15 (15-19 + 20-24) × 0.6, summed over Christian, Sikh, Buddhist and Jain. Other-minority numerator: 905,159; 18-23 proxy: 6,957,030.
By-sex GER: published All-India Minority enrolment by sex (AISHE 2021-22 Report prose) over Census 2011 C-15 18-23 population by sex; other minorities by sex = total Minority minus Muslim.
